chapter: Ellington years, Pearl Bailey and Jazz at the Philharmonic
title: Six weeks in Europe with Count Basie
summary: He filled in for Sonny Payne on a European tour with Basie's band, naming the sidemen.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Let me see. Who else was in that band? He was the only big star. The other guys were all good players, but Charlie was the main key. Then I had a chance to go to Europe with Basie. Sonny Payne got sick. I recorded with Basie – did an album with him. Then we left for Europe. I was supposed to go into Birdland with my small band, but they cancelled that out so I could help Basie out in Europe. That was six weeks there. Oh boy. That was a lot of fun. Thad Jones was in the band. Al Grey, Frank . . .
Yes, Frank – what was the other Frank?
Frank Wess and Frank Foster. Boy, what a band that was. The lead alto player was Marshall Royal. I mentioned Thad Jones, didn’t I?
It wasn’t a well-known player, but he was a good player.
